text._provenance: PLAN 2h.5 (2026-09-14, RUNNING_LOG §490–§491): piece #2's baked instruction texts, verbatim — composition_for_two_pianos_and_two_percussion/tools/notation_studio/engine/glyphs/text_paths.json (opentype.js render of CrimsonPro-LightItalic.ttf at the project's locked 1.0998 ss; 'LP magstep -6 corpus-confirmed'). Path units = ss, y down, origin top-left; anchors.baselineLeft = the text baseline at the left bearing. The composer, on the septet's plucked notes: 'bring over the proper pizz. … the right font and text … same size everything'.

pedal._provenance: PLAN 2h.5 (2026-09-14, RUNNING_LOG §490–§491): piece #2's Emmentaler sustain-pedal mark verbatim — composition_for_two_pianos_and_two_percussion/tools/notation_studio/engine/glyphs/pedal_paths.json (session 49, SustainPedal font-size -4, scaleFactor 0.7 baked in; the bbox fixed to the true visible extent in its session 66). Path units = ss, y down, origin top-left. 'Ped.' is the P-e-d glyph plus its period, one path. The composer: 'the proper pedal marking, the one we ported from LilyPond … same size'. No release sign in this piece — the release is the performance instructions' legend (§490, his choice A).

letRing._provenance: PLAN 2h.5 (2026-09-14, RUNNING_LOG §486): piece #2's let-ring (laissez-vibrer) crescent verbatim — composition_for_two_pianos_and_two_percussion/tools/notation_studio/engine/glyphs/let_ring_paths.json, baked there (session 77, 2026-05-23, bake_let_ring.js) from LilyPond 2.24's default \laissezVibrer at staff 20 / NoteHead -2, variant 3 (a stem-down open diamond), the composer's pick. Path units = ss; y down; the origin is the LEFT endpoint (the attachment); the peak rises 0.3725 above the attachment line; LilyPond strokes it at 0.1 (strokeSs) — the visual extent is 1.716 x 0.473. A fixed width: LilyPond's minimum-length does not stretch an l.v. tie. Placement is layout's letRing rule (container.json byTechnique._mainNote).
